statement: Nevada imposes no corporate income tax, but a commerce tax applies to each business entity whose Nevada gross revenue in a taxable year exceeds $4,000,000 (NRS 363C.200(1)), at industry-specific rates (NRS 363C.300-363C.560); an entity over the threshold files its return on or before the 45th day after the end of the taxable year, and the Department of Taxation does not require a return from entities at or below $4,000,000.
caveat: The commerce-tax taxable year is the state fiscal year (ending June 30), not the company's own; 'Nevada gross revenue' has its own situsing rules, and payroll-tax credits interact with the modified business tax. Verify thresholds and rates against the live statute and the Department of Taxation before relying.
